#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, sys, time, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import biggen

cfgs = []
for seed in range(3):
    for viol in (0.05, 0.2, 0.5):
        cfgs.append(dict(seed=seed, viol=viol))
for seed in range(2):
    cfgs.append(dict(seed=seed, viol=0.3, wide=False))
    cfgs.append(dict(seed=seed, viol=0.3, cap_scale=0.6))
    cfgs.append(dict(seed=seed, viol=0.3, max_faults=7))
    cfgs.append(dict(seed=seed, viol=0.15, ndoms=14, max_faults=14))
lines = []
for c in cfgs:
    seed = c.pop('seed')
    inst = biggen.build(seed, **c)
    lines.append(json.dumps(inst))
data = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
open('/workspace/tmp/perf.jsonl','w').write(data)
t0=time.time()
r = subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'], input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd='/')
el=time.time()-t0
print('total wall %.1fs rc=%d' % (el, r.returncode))
outs = [json.loads(l) for l in r.stdout.splitlines()]
for c, o in zip(cfgs, outs):
    print('%-60s -> %s k=%s' % (json.dumps(c)[:60], o['status'], o.get('min_faults')))
if r.stderr: print('STDERR:', r.stderr[:2000])
PYEOF
